name: Aquementas
objectiveText: Take the Book of Aquor , the Silvery Claws , and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris. Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas. After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge. Silver Totem of Aquementas  ( 1 ) Silvery Claws  ( 11 ) Irontree Heart  ( 1 ) Book of Aquor  ( 1 )

comments.body:
To save you from digging through countless Thottbot and Allakhazam posts, here's the summary:

[ul][li]The circle of stones is located at (70,50) in Tanaris, you can get there by going through the Lost Rigger Cove tunnel and it's on the southern side of the walled off complex.  Once you get to the other side, head towards the mountains and you'll see the stones.[/li]

[li]You have to loot ALL of the items from your [item=11617].  If you do not, you will not complete the quest.[/li]

[li]You have to remain inside the Circle of Stones until [npc=9453] becomes hostile.  He spawns from the beach and runs up towards the Circle of Stones.  During this time, he is "Friendly", and only once he reaches the stones does he become hostile.  He is Immune to Frost damage.[/li]

[li]As long as you have 1x [item=11173] and 11x [item=11172] in your bags, the moment he turns hostile, he will turn these items in your bag into [item=11522].  You do not have to kill him in order to progress further on this quest, however he is only a level 54 non-Elite, and should be a pushover by this time.  As a Frost Mage, I was able to kill him at 55 with Fire spells, alternating Frost Ward and Ice Barrier.[/li]
[/ul]

Go south until you see the walled pirate city.  Go right , to the back. Aggro the pirates if you want. The follow the wooden fence all the way around until it ends against the mountain. You can jump the fence to get INTO the compound. Then jump OUT again and voila...you'll see the circle of Aquementas. YOU MUST EMPTY the contents of the pack into your inventory BEFORE you fight him. Do that.. Go into circle. Right click on book and it will summon him.. He will be friendly, then he'll get mad and turn on you. Defeat him (Im lvl 55 Shammy and it took me 4 turns, Chain light, ES, WF w/ staff and ES again). It will automatically create the totem and put it into your inventory. Quest finished..

[quote]Thank you for contacting the World of Warcraft Game Master Department.

I finally found the circle of rocks thich is, indeed, SW of the pirate camp past the boats in the camp.  When you pass the boats and the camp itself you see a clear area with some trees; it looks sorta like a clearing with a dead-end.  You do not see the rocks from the coast so don't be fooled.  Keep going toward the dead-end and you'll see the circle of rocks.  When I took the items out of the bag it disappeared and I then had only the claws and the heart in my inventory.  He turns hostile immediately and watch that you never go too close to the edge of the circle in case he knocks you back.  The prompt tells you that Aquementas transforms the items and since I had my inventory open I saw the Silver Totem appear in my inventory, showing it is not necesary to kill him.  After you get the totem you just deliver it to J.D. it is slightly south and west of the pirate camp.  there is a large circle of stones.  use the book in there, and aquementas will yell and come to the stones. you have to stay in the stones until he turns agro, but I don't think you have to kill him.

As stated in the quest log, you must stay within the circle. So i suggest standing right at the edge of the circle as Aquementas will charge towards the circle and will turn red upon reaching the circle.

I received the totem before i was hit. So remember to stay at the within the edge of the circle NOT outside.

If you look on yr map - it is due east of the Caverns of Time (on shore side of hills/mountains).  The reference to the easternmost peninsula is a bit misleading that way.  It is tucked in among some hills.

Definitely open the pack & get all items in yr inventory - then when he begins to attack, the silver totem will be created.  I ended up killing him cuz figured he'd just follow me.

it's a long series - so those who don't have it will need to click back to earlier quests re linken.

Good Luck!

I just completed this as a level 50 hunter.  It summons a level 54 monster, but with a healing potion and healing my pet, we managed to take him out.

Like others have said, I don't think you have to defeat him because the totem ends up in your backpack at some point during the fight (or maybe at the beginning of the fight? I didn't look).

The stone circle is at 70, 50.  It's easiest to get there from the port.  Just don't forget to take the items from the bag before entering the circle to summon.
make sure you empty the contents of the bag into your inventory before you fight the guy, otherwise the totem will not be made.

You can use fire spells against him, and they work fine.  Put up your frost ward to absorb his damage, and just unload fire spells against him.  Make sure to unempty your pack before going into the circle, or the game will eat your items.  Location is 70,50.

If you're doing this as a lower-level, as was my 49 Combat Rogue, I quickly realized that fighting Aquementas was a waste of time, so I vanished. That failed (it happens: welcome to Classic) and I ended up in the Gadget GY. So I saved what could have been a long, arduous battle with many fails, expensive potions and a pretty good chance to die anyway. Even if I beat him, I'd still need to deal with those pirates, then a two-day ride across the Gobi Desert (the music is pretty good though) to get back to Gadget. 

Instead I left the gun, took the Totem and got a death port to my destination anyway. Worth considering. That's what I'll be doing next time.
